summary_1line: Vishwamitra tries to seize Vasishtha’s sacred cow Shabala by force; the distressed cow appeals to the sage as the king’s men drag her away.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sacred cow Shabala breaks free from the king’s attendants and runs weeping to place her head at the feet of sage Vasishtha in the forest hermitage.
Soldiers of King Vishwamitra drag the divine cow away from the hermitage while the sage stands calm before his thatched hut.
